event_name: Date 27 August 2022 Time 09:45 2022 BELGIAN GRAND PRIX 25 - 28 August 2022 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, summoned (document 33) and heard from the driver and team representative, have considered the following matter, and determine
fact: Failure to follow item 12 of the Race Director's Event Notes.
offence: Breach of Article 12.2.1.i) of the FIA International Sporting Code.
reason: The Stewards heard from the driver of Car 1 (Max Verstappen) and team representative and reviewed video evidence. At 17:59 during second practice, the driver of car 1 passed a car that was in line to do practice starts and cut into the line to do a practice start, thereby not leaving in the order he arrived. This is a breach of the Race Director's Event Notes and the Stewards issue a Warning.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
title: Offence Car 1 Practice Start Infringement
